scope: engineering only; temporary fake Python runners; no scientific inputs or MCMC

initial_launcher_failure.cause: Unnecessarily quoting all native command-line tokens made WSL treat its --cd option as a Linux command.
initial_launcher_failure.correction: Quote only empty arguments or arguments containing whitespace/quotes; retain ordinary option and distribution tokens unquoted.

successful_preliminary_delay_fixture.claim_limit: Preliminary lifetime evidence; precise post-monitor-close interval is measured by the separate reproducible acceptance harness.

acceptance_harness_debugging.issue: PS5 default RepoRoot expression evaluated PSScriptRoot as empty in parameter binding.
acceptance_harness_debugging.correction: Resolve an omitted RepoRoot inside the script body.

acceptance_harness_debugging.issue: Capturing the native launcher through a PowerShell pipeline delayed harness progress beyond the launcher lifetime.
acceptance_harness_debugging.correction: Use a separate hidden launcher process, verify its exit directly, and read its immutable launch manifest.

acceptance_harness_debugging.issue: File.ReadAllText on redirected stdout encountered a Windows sharing violation.
acceptance_harness_debugging.correction: Read test logs with explicit FileShare.ReadWrite|Delete and guaranteed handle disposal.

host_shutdown_cause: Not established by these tests. No claim that WSL idle shutdown caused the prior interruption.
